a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival, since we would have to get through two storm checks with empty units. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end up with 2 and both die, so contesting it hurts us both. I'm sorry the setup is this harsh. If the storm doesn't hit, I'll operate with you afterward to help refill the reserve for you.
